```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Load the dataset
password_data <- read_csv("DSL-StrongPasswordData.csv")

# View the first few rows
head(password_data)

# Check dimensions and structure
dim(password_data)
str(password_data)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

# Step 1.2: Filter to the best 10 typists from Project 1
top_10_users <- c("s002", "s020", "s040", "s057", "s022", "s027", "s033", "s036", "s042", "s043")
filtered_data <- password_data %>%
  filter(subject %in% top_10_users)

# Step 1.3: Create total timing features and typing count
Total_attempts <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    typing_count = row_number(),
    total_h_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("H.")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_ud_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("UD.")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_dd_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("DD.")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 1.4: Add session_id
Total_attempts <- Total_attempts %>%
  mutate(session_id = paste(subject, sessionIndex, sep = "_")) %>%
  arrange(subject, sessionIndex, rep)

# Step 1.5: Select and organize features
session_features <- Total_attempts %>%
  dplyr::select(session_id, subject, rep, typing_count, total_h_time, total_ud_time, total_dd_time)


```

```{r}
# Step 1.6: Function to reshape data up to a given number of reps
create_session_matrix <- function(max_reps = 50) {
  session_wide <- session_features %>%
    filter(rep <= max_reps) %>%
    mutate(rep = paste0("rep", rep)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = rep,
      values_from = c(typing_count, total_h_time, total_ud_time, total_dd_time),
      names_sep = "_"
    )
  return(session_wide)
}

# Step 1.7: Create and save session datasets for 1 to 50 reps
session_datasets <- list()
for (r in 1:50) {
  session_datasets[[r]] <- create_session_matrix(r)
  saveRDS(session_datasets[[r]], paste0("session_data_rep_", r, ".rds"))
}

# Optionally, store the data as RDS for reuse
for (r in 1:50) {
  saveRDS(session_datasets[[r]], paste0("session_data_rep_", r, ".rds"))
}
```

```{r}
session_data_r1 <- create_session_matrix(1)
View(session_data_r1)

```

Model Building and Evaluation using LDA

```{r}
library(caret)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
# Initialize results dataframe
lda_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# Function to run LDA model for a given rep count
run_lda_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  # Load session dataset for that rep count
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))
  
  # Drop session_id if it exists
  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }
  
  # Convert subject to factor
  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)
  
  # Setup cross-validation folds (5-fold CV)
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  accs <- c()
  confs <- c()
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]
    
    # Train LDA model
    lda_model <- lda(subject ~ ., data = train_data)
    
    # Predict
    predictions <- predict(lda_model, newdata = test_data)
    
    # Accuracy
    acc <- mean(predictions$class == test_data$subject)
    accs <- c(accs, acc)
    
    # Confidence = mean of max posterior probabilities
    max_conf <- apply(predictions$posterior, 1, max)
    confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))
  }
  
  # Return average metrics
  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs),
    confidence = mean(confs)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Run for reps 1 to 50
for (r in 1:50) {
  message("Running LDA for rep ", r)
  result <- run_lda_cv(r)
  
  lda_results <- lda_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Save results
write.csv(lda_results, "lda_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Plot accuracy and confidence vs reps
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(lda_results, aes(x = reps_used)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_accuracy), color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_confidence), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "LDA Accuracy and Confidence vs Repetitions",
       x = "Number of Repetitions Used",
       y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Confidence (Red)")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


MClustDA
```{r}
library(mclust)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
# Define reps you want to test
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50)

# Initialize results dataframe
mclust_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# Function for MclustDA CV
run_mclustda_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))
  
  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }
  
  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)
  
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]
    
    tryCatch({
      m_model <- MclustDA(train_data[, -1], class = train_data$subject)
      pred <- predict(m_model, newdata = test_data[, -1])
      
      acc <- mean(pred$classification == test_data$subject)
      accs <- c(accs, acc)
      
      # Posterior confidence
      max_conf <- apply(pred$z, 1, max)
      confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      accs <- c(accs, NA_real_)
      confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
    })
  }
  
  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Loop over selected reps
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  message("Running MclustDA for rep ", r)
  result <- run_mclustda_cv(r)
  
  mclust_results <- mclust_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
write.csv(mclust_results, "mclustda_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


Decision Tree
```{r}
library(rpart)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

```

```{r}
# Selected reps
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50)

# Initialize results dataframe
tree_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# Function to run Decision Tree with CV
run_tree_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))
  
  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }
  
  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)
  
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]
    
    tryCatch({
      tree_model <- rpart(subject ~ ., data = train_data, method = "class")
      pred_probs <- predict(tree_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")
      pred_class <- predict(tree_model, newdata = test_data, type = "class")
      
      acc <- mean(pred_class == test_data$subject)
      accs <- c(accs, acc)
      
      max_conf <- apply(pred_probs, 1, max)
      confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      accs <- c(accs, NA_real_)
      confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
    })
  }
  
  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Run for each repetition level

  tree_results <- tree_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
```

XGBoost
```{r}
install.packages("xgboost")
install.packages("Matrix")
library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```
```{r}
# Define reps
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50)

# Initialize results
xgb_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# XGBoost CV function
run_xgb_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))
  
  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }

  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)
  labels <- as.integer(data$subject) - 1  # convert to numeric (0 to 9)
  
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(labels, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    test_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(data), train_idx)
    
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(data[train_idx, -1]), label = labels[train_idx])
    dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(data[test_idx, -1]), label = labels[test_idx])
    
    watchlist <- list(train = dtrain)
    
    xgb_model <- xgb.train(
      data = dtrain,
      objective = "multi:softprob",
      num_class = length(unique(labels)),
      nrounds = 50,
      verbose = 0
    )
    
    pred_probs <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
    pred_matrix <- matrix(pred_probs, nrow = length(pred_probs)/length(unique(labels)), byrow = TRUE)
    pred_class <- max.col(pred_matrix) - 1
    
    acc <- mean(pred_class == labels[test_idx])
    accs <- c(accs, acc)
    
    confs <- c(confs, mean(apply(pred_matrix, 1, max)))
  }
  
  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# Run loop
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  message("Running XGBoost for rep ", r)
  result <- run_xgb_cv(r)
  
  xgb_results <- xgb_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
write.csv(xgb_results, "xgboost_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot
ggplot(xgb_results, aes(x = reps_used)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_accuracy), color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_confidence), color = "lightgreen", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "XGBoost Accuracy and Confidence vs Repetitions",
       x = "Number of Repetitions Used",
       y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Confidence (Light Green)")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

SVM
```{r}
library(e1071)     # For SVM
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
# Define reps
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50)

# Initialize results
svm_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# SVM function
run_svm_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))

  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }

  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)

  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]

    tryCatch({
      svm_model <- svm(subject ~ ., data = train_data, kernel = "radial", probability = TRUE)
      pred_class <- predict(svm_model, newdata = test_data, probability = TRUE)

      acc <- mean(pred_class == test_data$subject)
      accs <- c(accs, acc)

      probs <- attr(pred_class, "probabilities")
      if (!is.null(probs)) {
        max_conf <- apply(probs, 1, max)
        confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))
      } else {
        confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
      }

    }, error = function(e) {
      accs <- c(accs, NA_real_)
      confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
    })
  }

  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Run loop
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  message("Running SVM for rep ", r)
  result <- run_svm_cv(r)

  svm_results <- svm_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
write.csv(svm_results, "svm_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


FULL FEATURES APPROACH

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

# Step 1.1: Load the original DSL dataset
password_data <- read.csv("DSL-StrongPasswordData.csv")

# Step 1.2: Filter to top 10 typists
top_10_users <- c("s002", "s020", "s040", "s057", "s022", "s027", "s033", "s036", "s042", "s043")
filtered_data <- password_data %>%
  filter(subject %in% top_10_users)

# Step 1.3: Create typing totals and session ID
Total_attempts <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    typing_count = row_number(),
    total_h_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("H.")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_ud_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("UD.")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_dd_time = rowSums(across(starts_with("DD.")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(session_id = paste(subject, sessionIndex, sep = "_")) %>%
  arrange(subject, sessionIndex, rep)

# Step 1.4: Define which reps to process
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50)

# Step 1.5: Function to build session-level data with full features
create_full_feature_sessions <- function(max_reps = 50) {
  session_data <- Total_attempts %>%
    filter(rep <= max_reps) %>%
    mutate(rep = paste0("rep", rep)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = rep,
      values_from = c(starts_with("H."), starts_with("UD."), starts_with("DD."),
                      typing_count, total_h_time, total_ud_time, total_dd_time),
      names_sep = "_"
    )
  return(session_data)
}

# Step 1.6: Build and save new session .rds files
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  session_data <- create_full_feature_sessions(r)
  saveRDS(session_data, paste0("session_data_full_rep_", r, ".rds"))
}
```

```{r}
# Define reps to use
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50)

# Initialize results storage
rf_full_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# Random Forest CV function using full feature dataset
run_rf_full_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_full_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))

  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }

  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)

  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]

    tryCatch({
      rf_model <- randomForest(subject ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 100)
      pred_class <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
      pred_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")

      acc <- mean(pred_class == test_data$subject)
      accs <- c(accs, acc)

      max_conf <- apply(pred_probs, 1, max)
      confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))

    }, error = function(e) {
      accs <- c(accs, NA_real_)
      confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
    })
  }

  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

XGBoost

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


```

```{r}
# Define repetition levels
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50)

# Initialize results
xgb_full_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# XGBoost full feature CV function
run_xgb_full_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_full_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))
  
  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }
  
  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)
  labels <- as.integer(data$subject) - 1  # 0-based class labels

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(labels, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)

  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    test_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(data), train_idx)

    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(data[train_idx, -1]), label = labels[train_idx])
    dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(data[test_idx, -1]), label = labels[test_idx])

    xgb_model <- xgb.train(
      data = dtrain,
      objective = "multi:softprob",
      num_class = length(unique(labels)),
      nrounds = 50,
      verbose = 0
    )

    pred_probs <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
    pred_matrix <- matrix(pred_probs, nrow = length(pred_probs)/length(unique(labels)), byrow = TRUE)
    pred_class <- max.col(pred_matrix) - 1

    acc <- mean(pred_class == labels[test_idx])
    accs <- c(accs, acc)

    confs <- c(confs, mean(apply(pred_matrix, 1, max)))
  }

  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Loop through repetitions
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  message("Running XGBoost (full features) for rep ", r)
  result <- run_xgb_full_cv(r)

  xgb_full_results <- xgb_full_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
write.csv(xgb_full_results, "xgboost_full_features_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

MClustDA

```{r}
# Define reps to use
reps_to_run <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50)

# Initialize result storage
mclust_full_results <- data.frame(
  reps_used = integer(),
  avg_accuracy = numeric(),
  avg_confidence = numeric()
)

# MclustDA CV function for full feature set
run_mclust_full_cv <- function(rep_n) {
  data <- readRDS(paste0("session_data_full_rep_", rep_n, ".rds"))

  if ("session_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- dplyr::select(data, -session_id)
  }

  data$subject <- as.factor(data$subject)

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(data$subject, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)

  accs <- numeric(0)
  confs <- numeric(0)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
    test_data <- data[-train_idx, ]

    tryCatch({
      m_model <- MclustDA(train_data[, -1], class = train_data$subject)
      pred <- predict(m_model, newdata = test_data[, -1])

      acc <- mean(pred$classification == test_data$subject)
      accs <- c(accs, acc)

      max_conf <- apply(pred$z, 1, max)
      confs <- c(confs, mean(max_conf))

    }, error = function(e) {
      accs <- c(accs, NA_real_)
      confs <- c(confs, NA_real_)
    })
  }

  return(list(
    accuracy = mean(accs, na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confs, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Run loop for MclustDA
for (r in reps_to_run) {
  message("Running MclustDA (full features) for rep ", r)
  result <- run_mclust_full_cv(r)

  mclust_full_results <- mclust_full_results %>%
    add_row(
      reps_used = r,
      avg_accuracy = result$accuracy,
      avg_confidence = result$confidence
    )
}

# Save results
write.csv(mclust_full_results, "mclustda_full_features_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
